name: How long does it take to replace a window sash?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a window sash?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to replace a window sash depends on the number of sashes, their size, material, and the complexity of the installation. Typically, a single sash replacement can be completed in a few hours. For multiple sashes, especially within a single day, a skilled team can often handle several units. Overall, sash replacement is generally a quicker process compared to full window replacement, minimizing disruption to your daily routine. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Single sash replacement usually takes a few hours. Multiple sashes can often be done in a day, depending on complexity.
